verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents an official hosted MCP server at use.jitsu.com/mcp. Through it an agent can create destinations, wire streams, inspect Live Events (which include streaming delivery results and dead-lettered events) and edit Functions, using OAuth 2.1 for interactive clients or a personal API key when headless. It also has a public Management API covering sites, destinations, connections and syncs, plus a CLI, and a probe confirms the MCP docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline management, explicit evidence that MCP covers source creation (only the API mentions sites/connections), and a machine-fetchable OpenAPI spec (the probed candidate paths returned 404).
